who: *** Alejandro LERENA TRAIBEL *** (recorded until 14 Sept as LERENA LENGUAS)
born: *** UNDETERMINED BETWEEN 29 MAY 1843 AND 29 MAY 1845 *** - the act reads "que nacio el veinte y nueve de Mayo del pasado ano cuarenta y tres", but all three acts on that opening carry the identical phrase, including one for a different couple, so the year is a formula and not a statement
children / records: Baptised 7 January 1846 at La Mauricia, Villa de la Union, IMAGE READ. On that same morning Luis and Justiniana brought their own children to the same font and the two brothers stood for each other's
what is known about his parents: *** KNOWN AND PRIMARY: AVELINO LERENA and AMBROSIA TRAIBEL. *** Paternal grandparents named on the act as *** FRANCISCO *** and *** MARIA FERNANDEZ ***; maternal as JUAN and ISABEL CENTENO. He is the eldest known child of Avelino, and a NEPHEW - not a brother - of Luis Eugenio and Gilberto.

who: *** Alejandro M. LERENA *** (the tree indexes him Alejandro MAXIMO)
born: *** BORN BETWEEN 17 MARCH AND 6 NOVEMBER 1844 *** on the arithmetic of two acts - "de cuarenta y dos anos de edad" on 6 Nov 1886 and "de 43 anos" on 16 Mar 1888. The "1839" this table carried is a TREE VALUE, not a record, and it is *** FIVE YEARS OUT ***
wife: Julia BASSANI (indexed also Basani, Bossani, Barsani, Balani) - but see the note below: in 1886 he was a WIDOWER and she was SOLTERA
children / records: A large family, MONTEVIDEO FIRST and Buenos Aires later: Hector Narciso b. Montevideo 29 Oct 1886 and Emilia Alberta b. Montevideo 16 Mar 1888, then Elisa Cornelia 1905, Carmen Romualda 1907 and Maria Luisa 1908 baptised in Capital Federal; Julieta Eugenia m. Buenos Aires 1912; Hector and Romer Rosario in Argentine military records 1911-1936
what is known about his parents: *** STILL NOT NAMED BY ANY RECORD. *** The 1888 act is a PRINTED FORM with a ruled line reading "Que es nieta por linea paterna de ______". *** THE LINE IS BLANK. *** So is the maternal one. The form asked this archive's exact question and nobody wrote an answer on it - which is common on these forms and is NOT evidence that he could not have answered.

children / records: A son Alejandro Joaquin Narciso, born 29 Oct 1872, christened at the Cordon 29 May 1873. Index read only
what is known about his parents: Not known. Added to this table 22 September because a fourth Alejandro belongs in the count and this table was still titled "three".

who: Alejandro Lerena of the Trinidad orbit
wife: Severa FERNANDEZ; and a Barbara Lerena
children / records: Children indexed as Pedro, Justina, Carmelo Anselmo, Venancio, and a Bernabe Lorena - and BERNABE is one of the six Trinidad, Flores fathers
what is known about his parents: Not known. Belongs with the Trinidad kindred rather than the Montevideo house.
